<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.ItamKitRequests</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Scripted steps of the catalog flows «Gerät zurückgeben oder tauschen» and «Asset-Daten oder Standort ändern»</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ItamKitRequests</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * ItamKitRequests: the scripted steps of the two catalog flows of ITAM Toolkit 0.2.0.
 *
 *   «Gerät zurückgeben oder tauschen»   approver -> start_return -> (return task closed) -> complete_return
 *   «Asset-Daten oder Standort ändern»  approver -> apply_change
 *   both, after a rejection             reject
 *
 * The flows call run(step, ritmId) through the custom action «ITAM Toolkit: run request step».
 * Every step returns the ItamKitResult contract {success, status_code, message, data}; data carries
 * approver_user, approver_group and return_task for the flow's data pills.
 */
var ItamKitRequests = Class.create();

/** Reason of a device return -> state of the returned device and whether a replacement is needed. */
ItamKitRequests.REASONS = {
    defekt: {replacement: true, state: '6', substatus: 'pending_repair', label: 'defective'},
    tausch: {replacement: true, state: '6', substatus: 'available', label: 'exchange'},
    nicht_benoetigt: {replacement: false, state: '6', substatus: 'available', label: 'no longer needed'}
};

/** Change type of a data change request -> asset field (the CI has a field of the same name). */
ItamKitRequests.CHANGES = {
    standort: {field: 'location', variable: 'new_location', label: 'location'},
    kostenstelle: {field: 'cost_center', variable: 'new_cost_center', label: 'cost center'},
    zuordnung: {field: 'assigned_to', variable: 'new_assigned_to', label: 'assigned user'}
};

ItamKitRequests.STEPS = ['approver', 'start_return', 'complete_return', 'apply_change', 'reject'];
ItamKitRequests.RITM_CLOSED_COMPLETE = '3';
ItamKitRequests.RITM_CLOSED_INCOMPLETE = '4';

ItamKitRequests.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.fallbackGroup = ItamKitConfig.prop('requests.fallback_group', '');
    },

    /** Entry point of the custom flow action. */
    run: function (step, ritmId) {
        try {
            if (ItamKitRequests.STEPS.indexOf(step) < 0) {
                return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'Unknown step "' + step + '"; use one of ' + ItamKitRequests.STEPS.join(', '));
            }
            const ritm = new GlideRecord('sc_req_item');
            if (!ritmId || !ritm.get(ritmId)) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'Requested item not found: ' + ritmId);
            switch (step) {
                case 'approver': return this.approver(ritm);
                case 'start_return': return this.startReturn(ritm);
                case 'complete_return': return this.completeReturn(ritm);
                case 'apply_change': return this.applyChange(ritm);
                default: return this.reject(ritm);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'ItamKitRequests.' + step);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Who approves. Return/exchange: the manager of the requested-for user. Data change: the asset owner,
     * then the head of the asset's department (Fachbereich). Without an active person: the fallback group
     * (property requests.fallback_group, a group name), so the request does not get stuck.
     */
    approver: function (ritm) {
        const isChange = this._isChange(ritm);
        let person = null;
        let source = '';
        if (isChange) {
            const asset = this._asset(ritm.variables.asset.toString());
            if (!asset) return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'The request names no valid asset');
            if (this._activeUser(asset.owned_by)) {
                person = asset.owned_by;
                source = 'asset owner';
            } else if (this._activeUser(asset.department.dept_head)) {
                person = asset.department.dept_head;
                source = 'head of the department';
            }
        } else {
            const user = ritm.variables.requested_for.nil() ? ritm.requested_for : ritm.variables.requested_for;
            if (this._activeUser(user.manager)) {
                person = user.manager;
                source = 'manager of ' + user.getDisplayValue();
            }
        }
        const data = {approver_user: '', approver_group: '', source: source};
        if (person) {
            data.approver_user = person.toString();
            return ItamKitResult.ok(200, 'Approval by ' + person.getDisplayValue() + ' (' + source + ')', data);
        }
        const group = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        if (!this.fallbackGroup || !group.get('name', this.fallbackGroup)) {
            return ItamKitResult.fail(422, 'No approver: nobody found and property requests.fallback_group names no group');
        }
        data.approver_group = group.getUniqueValue();
        data.source = 'fallback group';
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, 'Approval by the group ' + group.getValue('name') + ' (no ' +
            (isChange ? 'asset owner or department head' : 'manager') + ' found)', data);
    },

    /** After the approval of a return: one return task, plus a replacement task for a defective or exchanged device. */
    startReturn: function (ritm) {
        const reason = ItamKitRequests.REASONS[ritm.variables.reason.toString()];
        if (!reason) return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'Unknown reason "' + ritm.variables.reason + '"');
        const asset = this._asset(ritm.variables.device.toString());
        if (!asset) return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'The request names no valid device');
        const userId = ritm.variables.requested_for.toString() || ritm.getValue('requested_for');
        if (asset.getValue('assigned_to') !== userId) {
            return ItamKitResult.fail(409, asset.getDisplayValue() + ' is not assigned to ' + ritm.variables.requested_for.getDisplayValue());
        }
        const existing = this._tasks(ritm);
        if (existing.return_task) {
            return ItamKitResult.ok(208, 'Tasks already exist for ' + ritm.getValue('number'), existing);
        }
        const returnTask = this._newTask(ritm, asset, 'Device return', 'Return ' + asset.getDisplayValue() + ' (' + reason.label + ')');
        let replacement = '';
        if (reason.replacement) {
            replacement = this._newTask(ritm, null, 'Device replacement', 'Provide a replacement for ' + asset.getDisplayValue() +
                ' (model ' + asset.model.getDisplayValue() + ')', asset.getValue('model'));
        }
        return ItamKitResult.ok(201, 'Return task' + (replacement ? ' and replacement task' : '') + ' created for ' + ritm.getValue('number'),
            {return_task: returnTask, replacement_task: replacement, approver_user: '', approver_group: ''});
    },

    /**
     * After the return task is closed: the returned device gets its state from the reason (OOTB values),
     * the assignment is removed, the CI is kept consistent with the OOTB asset/CI status mapping,
     * every change goes to the toolkit audit log, the requested item is closed.
     */
    completeReturn: function (ritm) {
        const tasks = this._tasks(ritm);
        const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
        if (!tasks.return_task || !task.get(tasks.return_task)) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'No return task for ' + ritm.getValue('number'));
        if (task.getValue('state') !== '3') return ItamKitResult.fail(409, task.getValue('number') + ' is not closed complete yet');
        const reason = ItamKitRequests.REASONS[ritm.variables.reason.toString()];
        const asset = this._asset(task.getValue('asset'));
        const base = {module: 'request', action: 'device_return', note: ritm.getValue('number') + ' (' + reason.label + ')'};

        const before = {install_status: asset.getValue('install_status'), substatus: asset.getValue('substatus'),
            assigned_to: asset.getValue('assigned_to')};
        if (before.install_status === reason.state && before.substatus === reason.substatus && !before.assigned_to) {
            return ItamKitResult.ok(208, asset.getDisplayValue() + ' is already returned');
        }
        asset.setValue('install_status', reason.state);
        asset.setValue('substatus', reason.substatus);
        asset.setValue('assigned_to', '');
        asset.update();
        asset.get(asset.getUniqueValue());
        let changes = ItamKitAudit.logChanges(Object.assign({table: 'alm_hardware', id: asset.getUniqueValue(), display: asset.getDisplayValue()}, base),
            before, {install_status: asset.getValue('install_status'), substatus: asset.getValue('substatus'),
                assigned_to: asset.getValue('assigned_to')});

        let ciNote = 'no CI';
        if (!asset.ci.nil()) {
            const drift = new AssetCiDrift();
            const expected = drift.expectedCiStatus(asset.getValue('install_status'), asset.getValue('substatus'));
            const ci = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci');
            ci.get(asset.getValue('ci'));
            ciNote = 'CI ' + ci.getDisplayValue() + ' consistent';
            if (expected && ci.getValue('install_status') !== expected) {
                const old = ci.getValue('install_status');
                ci.setValue('install_status', expected);
                ci.update();
                changes += ItamKitAudit.logChanges(Object.assign({table: ci.getValue('sys_class_name'), id: ci.getUniqueValue(),
                    display: ci.getDisplayValue(), leadingSide: 'asset'}, base), {install_status: old}, {install_status: expected});
                ciNote = 'CI ' + ci.getDisplayValue() + ' set to the mapped status';
            }
        }
        this._close(ritm, ItamKitRequests.RITM_CLOSED_COMPLETE, 'Device returned (' + reason.label + '): ' + asset.getDisplayValue() +
            ' is ' + asset.install_status.getDisplayValue() + ' / ' + asset.substatus.getDisplayValue() + '; ' + ciNote + '.');
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, asset.getDisplayValue() + ': ' + asset.install_status.getDisplayValue() + ' / ' +
            asset.substatus.getDisplayValue() + '; ' + ciNote + ' (' + changes + ' audit row(s))',
            {asset: asset.getDisplayValue(), audit_rows: changes});
    },

    /** After the approval of a data change: the asset and its CI get the new value; old and new go to the audit log. */
    applyChange: function (ritm) {
        const change = ItamKitRequests.CHANGES[ritm.variables.change_type.toString()];
        if (!change) return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'Unknown change type "' + ritm.variables.change_type + '"');
        // the new-value variables are optional (only the one for the chosen change type is shown)
        const answer = ritm.variables[change.variable];
        const value = answer ? answer.toString() : '';
        if (!value) return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'The request names no new ' + change.label);
        const asset = this._asset(ritm.variables.asset.toString());
        if (!asset) return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'The request names no valid asset');
        const base = {module: 'request', action: 'data_change', note: ritm.getValue('number') + ': ' + ritm.variables.justification};

        const records = [asset];
        if (!asset.ci.nil()) {
            const ci = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci');
            if (ci.get(asset.getValue('ci')) && ci.isValidField(change.field)) records.push(ci);
        }
        if (records.every(function (r) { return r.getValue(change.field) === value; })) {
            this._close(ritm, ItamKitRequests.RITM_CLOSED_COMPLETE, 'Nothing to change: the ' + change.label + ' was already set.');
            return ItamKitResult.ok(208, asset.getDisplayValue() + ' already has this ' + change.label);
        }
        let changes = 0;
        const names = [];
        records.forEach(function (record) {
            const old = record.getValue(change.field);
            if (old === value) return;
            record.setValue(change.field, value);
            record.update();
            changes += ItamKitAudit.logChanges(Object.assign({table: record.getValue('sys_class_name'), id: record.getUniqueValue(),
                display: record.getDisplayValue()}, base), {[change.field]: old}, {[change.field]: value});
            names.push(record.getDisplayValue());
        });
        const shown = records[0].getElement(change.field).getDisplayValue();
        this._close(ritm, ItamKitRequests.RITM_CLOSED_COMPLETE, 'Changed ' + change.label + ' to ' + shown + ' on ' + names.join(' and ') + '.');
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, change.label + ' set to ' + shown + ' on ' + names.join(' and ') + ' (' + changes + ' audit row(s))',
            {changed: names, audit_rows: changes});
    },

    /** After a rejection: nothing changes; the requested item is closed incomplete with the approver's comment. */
    reject: function (ritm) {
        const approval = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        approval.addQuery('sysapproval', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        approval.addQuery('state', 'rejected');
        approval.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
        approval.setLimit(1);
        approval.query();
        const comment = approval.next() ? approval.comments.getJournalEntry(1).replace(/^.*\n/, '').trim() : '';
        this._close(ritm, ItamKitRequests.RITM_CLOSED_INCOMPLETE, 'Rejected, nothing was changed.' + (comment ? ' Reason: ' + comment : ''));
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, ritm.getValue('number') + ' rejected; nothing changed' + (comment ? ' (reason: ' + comment + ')' : ''),
            {reason: comment});
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    _isChange: function (ritm) {
        return ritm.cat_item.name.toString() === 'Asset-Daten oder Standort ändern';
    },

    _asset: function (id) {
        const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        return id && asset.get(id) ? asset : null;
    },

    _activeUser: function (element) {
        return !element.nil() && ItamKitConfig.isTrue(element.active);
    },

    _tasks: function (ritm) {
        const found = {return_task: '', replacement_task: ''};
        const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
        task.addQuery('parent', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        task.query();
        while (task.next()) {
            if (task.getValue('task_name') === 'Device return') found.return_task = task.getUniqueValue();
            if (task.getValue('task_name') === 'Device replacement') found.replacement_task = task.getUniqueValue();
        }
        return found;
    },

    _newTask: function (ritm, asset, name, description, model) {
        const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
        task.initialize();
        task.setValue('parent', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        task.setValue('task_name', name);
        task.setValue('short_description', description);
        task.setValue('requested_for', ritm.variables.requested_for.toString() || ritm.getValue('requested_for'));
        if (asset) {
            task.setValue('asset', asset.getUniqueValue());
            task.setValue('model', asset.getValue('model'));
        } else if (model) {
            task.setValue('model', model);
        }
        if (ritm.getValue('assignment_group')) task.setValue('assignment_group', ritm.getValue('assignment_group'));
        return task.insert();
    },

    _close: function (ritm, state, note) {
        ritm.setValue('state', state);
        ritm.work_notes = note;
        ritm.update();
    },

    type: 'ItamKitRequests'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 13:57:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>2aa100b4c360571015b012d4e40131ee</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ItamKitRequests</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_2aa100b4c360571015b012d4e40131ee</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 14:51:39</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

14:38:04</sys_updated_on><value>/**
 * ATF test «ITAM Toolkit: Gerät zurückgeben oder tauschen», step «Run Server Side Script» (Jasmine 3.1).
 * Flow «Gerät zurückgeben oder tauschen»: the flow asks the manager (or the fallback group) for the
 * approval; after the approval a return task and, for a defective device, a replacement task; closing
 * the return task sets the OOTB end state, keeps the CI consistent and writes the audit log; a
 * rejection changes nothing. ATF rolls all changes back after the run.
 */
(function (outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    /**
     * Shared helpers of the two request ATF tests (copied into both test scripts by build_bundle_requests.py,
     * because an ATF step script cannot import another script).
     *
     * newRequest() inserts a requested item with its variables directly. The platform starts a catalog flow
     * from the business rule «Start FlowDesigner Flow» only on an update, so the test runs the item's flow
     * itself in the foreground (sn_fd.FlowAPI) up to the approval, checks who has to approve, and cancels the
     * waiting flow before it changes anything else. The steps after the approval are the same script the flow
     * calls (ItamKitRequests); ATF rolls everything back after the run.
     */
    const stamp = String(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue());
    const requests = new ItamKitRequests();

    function insert(table, values) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.initialize();
        Object.keys(values).forEach(function (k) {
            gr.setValue(k, values[k]);
        });
        return gr.insert();
    }

    function load(table, id) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.get(id);
        return gr;
    }

    function newUser(name, managerId) {
        return insert('sys_user', Object.assign({user_name: 'atf.itamkit.req.' + name + '.' + stamp, first_name: 'ATF', last_name: name,
            email: 'atf.req.' + name + '@example.com'}, managerId ? {manager: managerId} : {}));
    }

    /** Computer CI and its hardware asset in use; returns {ci, asset}. */
    function newDevice(name, values) {
        const ci = insert('cmdb_ci_computer', {name: 'ATF-REQ-' + name + '-' + stamp, install_status: '1'});
        const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        if (!asset.get('ci', ci)) {
            asset.initialize();
            asset.setValue('ci', ci);
        }
        asset.setValue('asset_tag', 'ATF-REQ-' + name + '-' + stamp);
        asset.setValue('install_status', '1');
        Object.keys(values || {}).forEach(function (k) {
            asset.setValue(k, values[k]);
        });
        const assetId = asset.isNewRecord() ? asset.insert() : (asset.update(), asset.getUniqueValue());
        return {ci: ci, asset: assetId};
    }

    function catalogItem(name) {
        const item = new GlideRecord('sc_cat_item');
        item.get('name', name);
        return item;
    }

    /** Requested item with variables, without starting the item's flow. */
    function newRequest(item, requestedFor, variables) {
        const ritm = insert('sc_req_item', {cat_item: item.getUniqueValue(), requested_for: requestedFor,
            short_description: item.getValue('name') + ' (ATF)'});
        Object.keys(variables).forEach(function (name) {
            const question = new GlideRecord('item_option_new');
            question.addQuery('cat_item', item.getUniqueValue());
            question.addQuery('name', name);
            question.query();
            question.next();
            const option = insert('sc_item_option', {item_option_new: question.getUniqueValue(), value: variables[name]});
            insert('sc_item_option_mtom', {request_item: ritm, sc_item_option: option});
        });
        return load('sc_req_item', ritm);
    }

    /**
     * Runs the item's flow in the foreground until it waits for the approval; returns the context id.
     * The foreground runner stops at the approval and reports that as an exception ("waiting state");
     * the approval records exist at that point, so the waiting context is looked up instead.
     */
    function runFlowToApproval(item, ritm) {
        const flow = item.flow_designer_flow.getRefRecord();
        const name = flow.sys_scope.scope.toString() + '.' + flow.getValue('internal_name');
        try {
            const result = sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().flow(name).inForeground()
                .withInputs({request_item: ritm, table_name: 'sc_req_item'}).run();
            return result.getContextId();
        } catch (e) {
            if (String(e).indexOf('waiting state') < 0) throw e;
            const context = new GlideRecord('sys_flow_context');
            context.addQuery('flow', flow.getUniqueValue());
            context.addQuery('state', 'WAITING');
            context.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            context.setLimit(1);
            context.query();
            return context.next() ? context.getUniqueValue() : '';
        }
    }

    function cancelFlow(contextId) {
        if (contextId) sn_fd.FlowAPI.cancel(contextId, 'ATF: stopped after the approval check');
    }

    /** sys_ids of the users asked to approve the requested item. */
    function approvers(ritm) {
        const ids = [];
        const approval = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        approval.addQuery('sysapproval', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        approval.query();
        while (approval.next()) ids.push(approval.getValue('approver'));
        return ids;
    }

    function groupMembers(groupName) {
        const ids = [];
        const member = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        member.addQuery('group.name', groupName);
        member.query();
        while (member.next()) ids.push(member.getValue('user'));
        return ids;
    }

    /** A rejected approval with a comment, as the approver would leave it. */
    function rejectWith(ritm, approverId, comment) {
        const approval = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        approval.initialize();
        approval.setValue('sysapproval', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        approval.setValue('source_table', 'sc_req_item');
        approval.setValue('document_id', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        approval.setValue('approver', approverId);
        approval.setValue('state', 'rejected');
        approval.comments = comment;
        return approval.insert();
    }

    function auditRows(recordId) {
        const audit = new GlideRecord(ItamKitConfig.table('audit_log'));
        audit.addQuery('target_id', recordId);
        audit.addQuery('module', 'request');
        audit.query();
        return audit.getRowCount();
    }
    const ITEM = 'Gerät zurückgeben oder tauschen';

    describe('catalog item and flow', function () {
        it('is active and bound to a published flow', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            expect(item.isValidRecord()).toBe(true);
            expect(ItamKitConfig.isTrue(item.active)).toBe(true);
            expect(item.flow_designer_flow.nil()).toBe(false);
            expect(item.flow_designer_flow.status.toString()).toBe('published');
        });
    });

    describe('happy path: manager approves, defective device', function () {
        it('routes the approval to the manager and processes the return', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            const boss = newUser('boss');
            const user = newUser('worker', boss);
            const device = newDevice('NB1', {assigned_to: user});
            const ritm = newRequest(item, user, {requested_for: user, device: device.asset, reason: 'defekt', comment: 'Display broken'});

            const context = runFlowToApproval(item, ritm);
            expect(approvers(ritm)).toContain(boss);
            cancelFlow(context);

            const started = requests.run('start_return', ritm.getUniqueValue());
            expect(started.status_code).toBe(201);
            expect(started.data.replacement_task).not.toBe('');
            expect(requests.run('start_return', ritm.getUniqueValue()).status_code).toBe(208);

            expect(requests.run('complete_return', ritm.getUniqueValue()).status_code).toBe(409);
            const task = load('asset_task', started.data.return_task);
            task.setValue('state', '3');
            task.update();

            const done = requests.run('complete_return', ritm.getUniqueValue());
            expect(done.success).toBe(true);
            expect(done.status_code).toBe(200);
            const asset = load('alm_hardware', device.asset);
            expect(asset.getValue('install_status')).toBe('6');
            expect(asset.getValue('substatus')).toBe('pending_repair');
            expect(asset.assigned_to.nil()).toBe(true);
            expect(load('cmdb_ci', device.ci).getValue('install_status')).toBe(new AssetCiDrift().expectedCiStatus('6', 'pending_repair'));
            expect(auditRows(device.asset)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
            expect(load('sc_req_item', ritm.getUniqueValue()).getValue('state')).toBe('3');
        });
    });

    describe('fallback group and rejection', function () {
        it('asks the fallback group when the user has no manager, and a rejection changes nothing', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            const user = newUser('nomanager');
            const device = newDevice('NB2', {assigned_to: user});
            const ritm = newRequest(item, user, {requested_for: user, device: device.asset, reason: 'nicht_benoetigt'});

            const who = requests.run('approver', ritm.getUniqueValue());
            expect(who.data.approver_user).toBe('');
            expect(who.data.approver_group).not.toBe('');
            const context = runFlowToApproval(item, ritm);
            const members = groupMembers(ItamKitConfig.prop('requests.fallback_group', ''));
            expect(members.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
            expect(approvers(ritm)).toContain(members[0]);
            cancelFlow(context);

            rejectWith(ritm, members[0], 'Gerät wird noch gebraucht');
            const rejected = requests.run('reject', ritm.getUniqueValue());
            expect(rejected.status_code).toBe(200);
            expect(rejected.data.reason).toContain('noch gebraucht');
            expect(load('sc_req_item', ritm.getUniqueValue()).getValue('state')).toBe('4');
            const asset = load('alm_hardware', device.asset);
            expect(asset.getValue('install_status')).toBe('1');
            expect(asset.getValue('assigned_to')).toBe(user);
        });
    });

    describe('validation', function () {
        it('rejects a device of somebody else, unknown steps and unknown requests', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            const user = newUser('requester');
            const other = newUser('other');
            const device = newDevice('NB3', {assigned_to: other});
            const ritm = newRequest(item, user, {requested_for: user, device: device.asset, reason: 'tausch'});
            expect(requests.run('start_return', ritm.getUniqueValue()).status_code).toBe(409);
            expect(requests.run('dance', ritm.getUniqueValue()).status_code).toBe(400);
            expect(requests.run('approver', '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef').status_code).toBe(404);
        });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

jasmine.getEnv().execute();

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_atf_step"><sys_atf_step action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><callable_outputs/><copied_from/><description>Run Server Side Validation Script</description><display_name>Run Server Side Script</display_name><inputs/><mugshots_cache_json/><notes/><order>1</order><step_config display_value="Run Server Side Script">41de4a935332120028bc29cac2dc349a</step_config><sys_class_name>sys_atf_step</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 13:58:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>9ac18cb4c3e0571015b012d4e401311b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Run Server Side Script</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_step_9ac18cb4c3e0571015b012d4e401311b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 14:38:04</sys_updated_on><table/><test display_value="ITAM Toolkit: Asset-Daten oder Standort ändern">92c14cb4c3e0571015b012d4e40131fa</test><timeout/><warning_message/></sys_atf_step><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=9ac18cb4c3e0571015b012d4e401311b"/><sys_variable_value action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><document>sys_atf_step</document><document_key>9ac18cb4c3e0571015b012d4e401311b</document_key><order>200</order><sys_class_name>sys_variable_value</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 13:58:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>1ac18cb4c3e0571015b012d4e401311d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 14:38:04</sys_updated_on><value>/**
 * ATF test «ITAM Toolkit: Asset-Daten oder Standort ändern», step «Run Server Side Script» (Jasmine 3.1).
 * Flow «Asset-Daten oder Standort ändern»: the flow asks the asset owner, else the head of the asset's
 * department, else the fallback group; after the approval the new value is written to the asset and its
 * CI with old and new value in the audit log; a rejection changes nothing. ATF rolls all changes back.
 */
(function (outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    /**
     * Shared helpers of the two request ATF tests (copied into both test scripts by build_bundle_requests.py,
     * because an ATF step script cannot import another script).
     *
     * newRequest() inserts a requested item with its variables directly. The platform starts a catalog flow
     * from the business rule «Start FlowDesigner Flow» only on an update, so the test runs the item's flow
     * itself in the foreground (sn_fd.FlowAPI) up to the approval, checks who has to approve, and cancels the
     * waiting flow before it changes anything else. The steps after the approval are the same script the flow
     * calls (ItamKitRequests); ATF rolls everything back after the run.
     */
    const stamp = String(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue());
    const requests = new ItamKitRequests();

    function insert(table, values) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.initialize();
        Object.keys(values).forEach(function (k) {
            gr.setValue(k, values[k]);
        });
        return gr.insert();
    }

    function load(table, id) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.get(id);
        return gr;
    }

    function newUser(name, managerId) {
        return insert('sys_user', Object.assign({user_name: 'atf.itamkit.req.' + name + '.' + stamp, first_name: 'ATF', last_name: name,
            email: 'atf.req.' + name + '@example.com'}, managerId ? {manager: managerId} : {}));
    }

    /** Computer CI and its hardware asset in use; returns {ci, asset}. */
    function newDevice(name, values) {
        const ci = insert('cmdb_ci_computer', {name: 'ATF-REQ-' + name + '-' + stamp, install_status: '1'});
        const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        if (!asset.get('ci', ci)) {
            asset.initialize();
            asset.setValue('ci', ci);
        }
        asset.setValue('asset_tag', 'ATF-REQ-' + name + '-' + stamp);
        asset.setValue('install_status', '1');
        Object.keys(values || {}).forEach(function (k) {
            asset.setValue(k, values[k]);
        });
        const assetId = asset.isNewRecord() ? asset.insert() : (asset.update(), asset.getUniqueValue());
        return {ci: ci, asset: assetId};
    }

    function catalogItem(name) {
        const item = new GlideRecord('sc_cat_item');
        item.get('name', name);
        return item;
    }

    /** Requested item with variables, without starting the item's flow. */
    function newRequest(item, requestedFor, variables) {
        const ritm = insert('sc_req_item', {cat_item: item.getUniqueValue(), requested_for: requestedFor,
            short_description: item.getValue('name') + ' (ATF)'});
        Object.keys(variables).forEach(function (name) {
            const question = new GlideRecord('item_option_new');
            question.addQuery('cat_item', item.getUniqueValue());
            question.addQuery('name', name);
            question.query();
            question.next();
            const option = insert('sc_item_option', {item_option_new: question.getUniqueValue(), value: variables[name]});
            insert('sc_item_option_mtom', {request_item: ritm, sc_item_option: option});
        });
        return load('sc_req_item', ritm);
    }

    /**
     * Runs the item's flow in the foreground until it waits for the approval; returns the context id.
     * The foreground runner stops at the approval and reports that as an exception ("waiting state");
     * the approval records exist at that point, so the waiting context is looked up instead.
     */
    function runFlowToApproval(item, ritm) {
        const flow = item.flow_designer_flow.getRefRecord();
        const name = flow.sys_scope.scope.toString() + '.' + flow.getValue('internal_name');
        try {
            const result = sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().flow(name).inForeground()
                .withInputs({request_item: ritm, table_name: 'sc_req_item'}).run();
            return result.getContextId();
        } catch (e) {
            if (String(e).indexOf('waiting state') < 0) throw e;
            const context = new GlideRecord('sys_flow_context');
            context.addQuery('flow', flow.getUniqueValue());
            context.addQuery('state', 'WAITING');
            context.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            context.setLimit(1);
            context.query();
            return context.next() ? context.getUniqueValue() : '';
        }
    }

    function cancelFlow(contextId) {
        if (contextId) sn_fd.FlowAPI.cancel(contextId, 'ATF: stopped after the approval check');
    }

    /** sys_ids of the users asked to approve the requested item. */
    function approvers(ritm) {
        const ids = [];
        const approval = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        approval.addQuery('sysapproval', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        approval.query();
        while (approval.next()) ids.push(approval.getValue('approver'));
        return ids;
    }

    function groupMembers(groupName) {
        const ids = [];
        const member = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        member.addQuery('group.name', groupName);
        member.query();
        while (member.next()) ids.push(member.getValue('user'));
        return ids;
    }

    /** A rejected approval with a comment, as the approver would leave it. */
    function rejectWith(ritm, approverId, comment) {
        const approval = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
        approval.initialize();
        approval.setValue('sysapproval', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        approval.setValue('source_table', 'sc_req_item');
        approval.setValue('document_id', ritm.getUniqueValue());
        approval.setValue('approver', approverId);
        approval.setValue('state', 'rejected');
        approval.comments = comment;
        return approval.insert();
    }

    function auditRows(recordId) {
        const audit = new GlideRecord(ItamKitConfig.table('audit_log'));
        audit.addQuery('target_id', recordId);
        audit.addQuery('module', 'request');
        audit.query();
        return audit.getRowCount();
    }
    const ITEM = 'Asset-Daten oder Standort ändern';

    function otherLocation(current) {
        return insert('cmn_location', {name: 'ATF Standort ' + stamp + (current ? ' 2' : '')});
    }

    describe('catalog item and flow', function () {
        it('is active and bound to a published flow', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            expect(item.isValidRecord()).toBe(true);
            expect(ItamKitConfig.isTrue(item.active)).toBe(true);
            expect(item.flow_designer_flow.status.toString()).toBe('published');
        });
    });

    describe('happy path: asset owner approves a new location', function () {
        it('routes the approval to the owner and writes asset, CI and audit log', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            const owner = newUser('owner');
            const oldLocation = otherLocation(false);
            const device = newDevice('CH1', {owned_by: owner, location: oldLocation});
            const newLocation = otherLocation(true);
            const ritm = newRequest(item, owner, {asset: device.asset, change_type: 'standort', new_location: newLocation,
                justification: 'Umzug in das neue Büro'});

            const context = runFlowToApproval(item, ritm);
            expect(approvers(ritm)).toContain(owner);
            cancelFlow(context);

            const applied = requests.run('apply_change', ritm.getUniqueValue());
            expect(applied.success).toBe(true);
            expect(applied.status_code).toBe(200);
            expect(load('alm_hardware', device.asset).getValue('location')).toBe(newLocation);
            expect(load('cmdb_ci', device.ci).getValue('location')).toBe(newLocation);
            expect(auditRows(device.asset)).toBe(1);
            expect(auditRows(device.ci)).toBeLessThan(2);
            expect(load('sc_req_item', ritm.getUniqueValue()).getValue('state')).toBe('3');
            expect(requests.run('apply_change', ritm.getUniqueValue()).status_code).toBe(208);
        });

        it('asks the head of the department when the asset has no owner', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            const head = newUser('depthead');
            const department = insert('cmn_department', {name: 'ATF Abteilung ' + stamp, dept_head: head});
            const device = newDevice('CH2', {department: department});
            const ritm = newRequest(item, head, {asset: device.asset, change_type: 'standort', new_location: otherLocation(true),
                justification: 'Test'});
            const who = requests.run('approver', ritm.getUniqueValue());
            expect(who.data.approver_user).toBe(head);
            expect(who.data.source).toBe('head of the department');
        });
    });

    describe('fallback group and rejection', function () {
        it('asks the fallback group when nobody is responsible, and a rejection changes nothing', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            const oldLocation = otherLocation(false);
            const device = newDevice('CH3', {location: oldLocation});
            const requester = newUser('requester');
            const ritm = newRequest(item, requester, {asset: device.asset, change_type: 'standort', new_location: otherLocation(true),
                justification: 'Bitte verschieben'});

            const context = runFlowToApproval(item, ritm);
            const members = groupMembers(ItamKitConfig.prop('requests.fallback_group', ''));
            expect(approvers(ritm)).toContain(members[0]);
            cancelFlow(context);

            rejectWith(ritm, members[0], 'Standort ist falsch angegeben');
            const rejected = requests.run('reject', ritm.getUniqueValue());
            expect(rejected.status_code).toBe(200);
            expect(load('sc_req_item', ritm.getUniqueValue()).getValue('state')).toBe('4');
            expect(load('alm_hardware', device.asset).getValue('location')).toBe(oldLocation);
            expect(auditRows(device.asset)).toBe(0);
        });
    });

    describe('validation', function () {
        it('rejects a request without the new value', function () {
            const item = catalogItem(ITEM);
            const device = newDevice('CH4', {});
            const ritm = newRequest(item, newUser('val'), {asset: device.asset, change_type: 'kostenstelle', justification: 'x'});
            expect(requests.run('apply_change', ritm.getUniqueValue()).status_code).toBe(400);
        });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
